id: 09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs
title: 工作危害分析十问（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/09_Test Your Knowledge of Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) Job Safety Analysis (JSA) MCQs（国内版）/src.py

points.K3: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
points.K7: 让做这项工作的人参与
points.K10: 优先分析出过事的作业
points.S1: 双重预防机制与危害告知
points.S2: 实验前风险评估与准入
points.S4: 移液等重复操作防劳损
points.S5: 个体防护是最后一道防线

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，手拿一张空白分析表，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a laboratory door holding a blank analysis sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，学会工作危害分析。

shots.scene: 一行图标：分解的台阶、放大镜、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A row of three simple icons: a staircase of steps, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤、找危害、定措施，一步不落。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱起一个沉重的纸箱，弯着腰，准备搬上架子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends deeply at the waist to pick up a heavy closed cardboard box from the lab floor.
shots.narration: 阿杰要开新实验，先得搬一箱试剂。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着长长的移液任务清单，揉手腕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a long blank task list beside a row of tube racks and rubs his wrist.
shots.narration: 接下来还有几百次移液等着他。

shots.scene: 老周走过来，按住箱子，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over, puts a hand on the box and shakes his head kindly.
shots.narration: 老周拦住他：先做危害分析再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：危害分析到底怎么做？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白卡片，上面画着问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a question mark pictogram and smiles.
shots.narration: 我们边答题边学，一共十道。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个实验台，四周有四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a lab bench surrounded by four floating icons: a map pin, a person, a lightning spark and a warning triangle.
shots.narration: 第一题：描述危害要讲清哪几个方面？

shots.scene: 地图定位图标落在实验台的一角
shots.prompt_en: A map pin icon lands on one corner of a lab bench near the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 环境：危害在哪里发生。

shots.scene: 人形图标被箭头指向
shots.prompt_en: An arrow points at a simple person icon standing beside the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露：会伤到谁，或损坏什么。

shots.scene: 一只脚踢到纸箱的图标，闪光
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a foot catching on a box on the floor with a small flash. No people.
shots.narration: 触发：是什么动作或条件引发了它。

shots.scene: 警示三角下面画一个摔倒的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle above a simple icon of a falling person. No people.
shots.narration: 后果：不加控制，最可能出什么事。

shots.scene: 四个图标合拢成一个整圆，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons join together into one complete circle with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是四个都要写，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 小研在空白分析表上逐栏填写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in four blank columns of an analysis sheet with simple icons.
shots.narration: 写全这四点，别人一看就明白风险。

shots.scene: 三张卡片：盾牌、法槌、扫帚
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards in a row showing a shield icon, a judge gavel icon and a broom icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：做危害分析，图的是什么？

shots.scene: 法槌卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The gavel card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是给上级处分员工找依据。

shots.scene: 扫帚卡片打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The broom card is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不是给轻岗人员找点事做。

shots.scene: 盾牌卡片亮起，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The shield card glows with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是消除和预防工作中的危害。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰一起看分析表，点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student look at a blank analysis sheet together and nod.
shots.narration: 分析做在前面，伤害就少在后面。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 一叠空白记录本，上面有感叹号图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank record books with a yellow exclamation icon on top. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：要不要先翻以往的事故记录？
overlay: 先回顾事故和未遂记录

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，翻开记录本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and opens a blank record book.
shots.narration: 答案是要，这句话正确。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 记录本里两个图标：受伤的绷带、差点摔倒的人
shots.prompt_en: Inside the book two icons: a bandage and a person nearly slipping but catching balance. No people.
shots.narration: 受过伤的、差点出事的，都要看。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 实验室平面图上一处闪红光
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab floor plan with one spot flashing red. No people.
shots.narration: 出过事的地方，往往还藏着危害。

shots.section_title: 先回顾事故和未遂记录
shots.scene: 小研在平面图红点处画圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student circles the red spot on the floor plan with a marker.
shots.narration: 先把重点放在这些地方。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着通风柜图标的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a card showing a fume hood icon.
shots.narration: 第四题：工程控制是不是最有效？

shots.scene: 原片答案“正确”的卡片，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A card with a check mark and a small question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答正确，但这里要多想一步。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层，从上到下颜色由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid divided into five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施有先后顺序。

shots.scene: 金字塔顶两层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The top two layers of the inverted pyramid glow brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 能消除、能替代，效果最好。

shots.scene: 第三层亮起，通风柜和防护罩图标
shots.prompt_en: The third layer glows, with fume hood and machine guard icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制把人和危害隔开，排第三。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，指着金字塔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to the inverted pyramid.
shots.narration: 它比管理和防护用品更可靠。

shots.scene: 三张卡片，第三张画着台阶、放大镜和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards; the third shows a staircase, a magnifying glass and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：危害分析的基本思路是什么？

shots.scene: 实验流程被切成一节一节的方块
shots.prompt_en: A long arrow representing a lab task is cut into several numbered blocks without text. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，把作业拆成一个个步骤。

shots.scene: 放大镜依次扫过每个方块
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves over each block one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，逐个步骤找出危害。

shots.scene: 每个方块旁边出现一个小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A small shield appears beside each block. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，为每个危害定好控制措施。

shots.scene: 小研把三栏分析表贴在实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins a blank three-column analysis sheet on the wall beside a lab bench.
shots.narration: 步骤、危害、措施，三栏对应。

shots.scene: 另两张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two other cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 只列频率、技能，抓不住具体危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰抬起地上的沉重纸箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends down to lift a heavy closed box from the floor.
shots.narration: 第六题：弯腰搬重物，危害怎么描述？

shots.scene: 三张图标卡片：插头火花、腰部红点、振动波纹
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a sparking plug icon, a human back with a red spot at the lower back, and a vibration wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 触电、腰背劳损、振动伤神经？

shots.scene: 火花和振动卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: The sparking plug card and the vibration card are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 搬箱子不涉及电和振动。

shots.scene: 人体侧影，下背部红色高亮，伴有扭转箭头
shots.prompt_en: A side silhouette of a person bending and twisting with the lower back highlighted in red and a curved twisting arrow.
shots.narration: 伸手、扭身，容易拉伤下背部。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，指着腰部卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the lower back card.
shots.narration: 好的描述，说清动作和伤到哪里。

shots.scene: 空白分析表上一行：弯腰图标、腰背图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank analysis sheet row with a bending person icon and a lower back icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体的描述，才能对症下措施。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 老周一个人坐在办公桌前填表，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The older man fills in a form alone at an office desk; a red X appears over the scene.
shots.narration: 第七题：只让负责人来做，对吗？
overlay: 让做这项工作的人参与

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 不对，这句话是错误的。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台边比划操作动作，老周认真记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student demonstrates how he does a task at the bench while the older man takes notes.
shots.narration: 天天动手的人，最清楚哪里危险。

shots.section_title: 让做这项工作的人参与
shots.scene: 阿杰指着工具，提出一条建议，灯泡亮起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a tool and a light bulb appears above his head.
shots.narration: 也最知道该加什么预防措施。

shots.scene: 一张填空卡，三个空格
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with three empty boxes in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：危害分析是什么？

shots.scene: 第一个空格填入放大镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon drops into the first box. No people.
shots.narration: 它是辨识危害的方法，

shots.scene: 第二个空格填入切开的方块图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a block cut into pieces drops into the second box. No people.
shots.narration: 是把作业分解开来的手段，

shots.scene: 第三个空格填入一群人看警示牌的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several people looking at a warning triangle drops into the third box. No people.
shots.narration: 也帮大家看懂身边的危害。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在角落里填表，头上满是问号
shots.prompt_en: A single person icon sits alone in a corner filling a form, surrounded by question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：一个人做，就不会混乱？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 错误，有疑问更要大家一起讨论。

shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰、王老师围桌讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator discuss around a table.
shots.narration: 负责人、学生、安全员一起看。

shots.scene: 问号逐个消失，变成勾
shots.prompt_en: Question marks above the table turn into check marks one by one.
shots.narration: 多双眼睛，漏掉的危害更少。

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 几张作业卡片排队，其中一张带绷带图标
shots.prompt_en: Several blank task cards in a line; one card has a bandage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：先分析出过事的作业吗？
overlay: 优先分析出过事的作业

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，把带绷带的卡片拿到最前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and moves the bandage card to the front of the line.
shots.narration: 正确，出过伤害的作业排第一。

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 第二张卡片带感叹号，排到第二
shots.prompt_en: A card with an exclamation icon moves to the second position. No people.
shots.narration: 差点出事的、后果严重的紧随其后。

shots.section_title: 优先分析出过事的作业
shots.scene: 小研给排好顺序的卡片编号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the ordered cards on a board one by one.
shots.narration: 按轻重缓急，逐项做分析。

shots.section_title: 双重预防机制与危害告知
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排法律书前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of closed blank law books.
shots.narration: 国内法律也要求做好危害辨识。
overlay: 双重预防机制与危害告知

shots.section_title: 双重预防机制与危害告知
shots.scene: 两层盾牌图标：风险分级、隐患排查
shots.prompt_en: Two linked shield icons, one with a ladder of levels and one with a magnifier. No people.
shots.narration: 安全生产法要求风险分级管控、排查隐患。

shots.section_title: 双重预防机制与危害告知
shots.scene: 职业病危害因素图标：噪声、粉尘、化学瓶、弯腰人形
shots.prompt_en: Icons of occupational hazard factors: noise waves, dust cloud, chemical bottle and a bending person. No people.
shots.narration: 职业病防治法要求辨识危害因素。

shots.section_title: 双重预防机制与危害告知
shots.scene: 王老师向学生发放空白告知卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands blank information cards to a group of students.
shots.narration: 还要如实告知，做好培训和防护。

shots.section_title: 双重预防机制与危害告知
shots.scene: 一本书上叠一个图章图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon on it. No people.
shots.narration: 具体条款和限值，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 实验前风险评估与准入
shots.scene: 小研坐在桌前，填写空白风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits at a desk filling in a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 高校实验，开始前先做风险评估。
overlay: 实验前风险评估与准入

shots.section_title: 实验前风险评估与准入
shots.scene: 风险矩阵图：可能性和严重度两轴，格子由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: A simple risk matrix grid with two axes and cells shading from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 看可能性，也看后果有多严重。

shots.section_title: 实验前风险评估与准入
shots.scene: 老周在评估表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank risk assessment form at his desk.
shots.narration: 导师审核签字，措施到位再开工。

shots.section_title: 实验前风险评估与准入
shots.scene: 阿杰出示培训合格卡，刷卡进入实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows a blank training card and badges into the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 通过安全培训和准入，才能进实验室。

shots.section_title: 实验前风险评估与准入
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层楼图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked building icons of different sizes linked by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，层层有责任。

shots.scene: 分析表上新增一栏，画着弯腰、手腕和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank analysis sheet gets a new column showing icons of a bending person, a wrist and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 分析时别漏了工效学危害。

shots.scene: 人形图标弯腰、踮脚、扭身，逐个闪红
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person bending low, reaching up on tiptoe and twisting, each flashing red in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 别扭姿势：弯腰、够高、扭身。

shots.scene: 手指用力按压的图标和重箱图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thumb pressing hard and an icon of a heavy box. No people.
shots.narration: 用力过大：按压过紧、搬得太重。

shots.scene: 时钟图标转了很多圈，旁边是重复箭头
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon spinning many turns beside a circular repeat arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 重复次数多、持续时间长，风险叠加。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱放上推车，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places the heavy box onto a small lab trolley; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 找到了，就用推车、调台面来控制。

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 小研连续移液，手腕上出现红色光点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pipettes repeatedly; a small red glow appears on her wrist.
shots.narration: 成百上千次移液，手腕也会劳损。
overlay: 移液等重复操作防劳损

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 手腕、肩颈、腰背三个红点图标
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with red dots on the wrist, the neck and shoulders, and the lower back. No people.
shots.narration: 重复动作、别扭姿势，伤的是关节肌肉。

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 小研换用轻便移液器，调高椅子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches to a light pipette and adjusts her chair height.
shots.narration: 选轻便工具，调好座椅和台面高度。

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 物品放在伸手可及的范围内
shots.prompt_en: Tube racks and tips arranged within easy arm reach on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 常用物品放在顺手的地方。

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 小研放下移液器，活动手腕和肩膀
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts down the pipette and stretches her wrists and shoulders.
shots.narration: 定时停一停，活动手腕和肩颈。

shots.section_title: 移液等重复操作防劳损
shots.scene: 小研向老周说明手腕不适
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks to the older man while holding her wrist.
shots.narration: 酸痛麻木持续，及早报告就医。

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 倒金字塔最底层亮起，旁边是手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer of the inverted pyramid glows, with gloves and goggles beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 个体防护排在最后一层。
overlay: 个体防护是最后一道防线

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and gloves at the bench.
shots.narration: 前面措施做足，防护用品照样要戴。

shots.section_title: 个体防护是最后一道防线
shots.scene: 只靠一副手套挡危害的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single glove facing a big hazard symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能只靠它，替代上面的措施。

shots.scene: 实验流程图上一步被替换，闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A task flow chart where one block is swapped for a new block that flashes. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂、设备、步骤一变，就要复评。

shots.scene: 小试管换成大烧瓶的图标，箭头变粗
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small test tube changing into a large flask, with a thicker arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用量放大，危害也可能跟着放大。

shots.scene: 新来的同学站在实验台前，王老师讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank analysis sheet to a new student at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 换了人、换了场地，同样要重新看。

shots.scene: 小研更新分析表，老周签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student updates the analysis sheet and the older man signs it.
shots.narration: 更新后重新审核，再讲给每个人听。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by a whiteboard with four icons: steps, magnifier, shield and people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤、找危害、定措施、全员参与。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔再次出现
shots.prompt_en: The inverted pyramid of controls appears again. No people.
shots.narration: 措施先消除替代，再工程管理防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰推着推车，小研移液间隙伸展手腕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a trolley while the female graduate student stretches her wrists between tasks.
shots.narration: 搬运用工具，重复操作勤调整。

shots.scene: 老周在分析表上签字，众人点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the analysis sheet while the others nod.
shots.narration: 评估签字，有变化就重新评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别，身后是整洁的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy laboratory.
shots.narration: 先分析再动手，安全每一步！
